[1/5] Plan: complete in-system transit (TravelState), planetary civilization metadata (faction, population, government), and realtime cockpit popup events (GameEvent) across models, galaxy, engine, server, CLI, and cockpit HUD

impact_assessment.why: Uncommitted models in voidfarer/models.py introduced TravelState, GameEvent, and planetary civilization fields (faction, population, government) without serialization in GameState, procedural generation in galaxy.py, simulation/tick wiring in engine.py, or REST/CLI/HUD controls
impact_assessment.benefits: Players gain sublight and quantum in-system transit with tick-based progress, inhabited planets display faction/population/government metadata, and major simulation events surface as dismissible cockpit alerts while preserving 100% backward compatibility with all 238 existing tests
impact_assessment.risks: contract: existing engine.orbit(body_id) callers expect instant orbit; dependency: stdlib only; concurrency: all travel and event mutations must run inside engine.lock; state: old saves lack events/travel/population fields
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep orbit(body_id) immediate and add start_travel(body_id, mode) + /api/travel + CLI travel; backfill civilization fields in _bootstrap_frontier and default events/travel safely in from_dict; escape all HUD event strings; verify with failing-first tests and aikit check voidfarer

[1/4] Add ESC menu hotkey, multiple save slots across storage/REST/CLI/cockpit, and full-viewport background NAV-Radar orbital map (G-004)

impact_assessment.why: Deliver user-requested ESC menu toggle, multi-slot save/load/delete/list persistence across backend and cockpit UI, and full-screen background orbital radar map with all HUD decks floating on top
impact_assessment.benefits: Instant ESC menu/modal control, independent named/numbered save slots with rich metadata and default-slot backward compatibility, and an immersive full-viewport interactive orbital radar background
impact_assessment.risks: contract: /api/save, /api/load, /api/delete-save and StorageManager must stay backward-compatible with no-arg callers; dependency: zero external dependencies; concurrency: StorageManager write lock and engine lock must guard multi-slot operations; state: CSS backdrop-filter on parent containers would trap position:fixed radar if not cleared on #panelCenter/#panelNav
impact_assessment.mitigation: Default slot=None to voidfarer_save.json, validate slot identifiers against path traversal, reuse atomic write + .bak recovery per slot, remove ancestor backdrop-filter on #panelCenter/#panelNav while keeping HUD cards elevated at z-index>=2 with pointer-events pass-through
